target_customer: Pharma and biotech teams and diagnostics companies selecting trial patients or needing spatial biology data
problem: Spatial protein data is costly and uses scarce tissue. Strand's Lattice model predicts spatial protein marker maps from routine H&E slides.
business_model: dry lab service plus custom model partnerships and an API platform (pricing not stated)

founders.name: Oded Falik
prior_employers: Enable Medicine (tech lead for spatial biology platform)

competitors.name: GigaTIME
competitors.what: Cell paper model translating H&E slides to 21-channel virtual mIF
competitors.traction_then: academic model from Providence, UW and Microsoft

technical_complexity.rationale: Predicting spatial protein channels from H&E requires paired multimodal data and validated models, a research-grade problem for a two-person team.

defensibility.rationale: Access to paired spatial datasets and the founders' Enable Medicine experience may help, but academic groups and companies were publishing similar methods.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Proscia integrated virtual staining and others presented at USCAP 2026. No action against Strand AI reported.

market_need_then: Pharma wants spatial biomarkers without extra tissue, and academic papers in 2025 and 2026 showed strong interest in virtual multiplex staining.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific; describes goal as the missing data layer for biology.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: the missing data layer for biology

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the brand. Product names Lattice and POSTMAN appear in company pages; POSTMAN overlaps with the unrelated API tool Postman.

outcome_analysis: Strand AI joined YC in Winter 2026 as a two-person team of ex-Enable Medicine staff and is Active. It sells Lattice outputs as a dry lab service and API. No funding, exit or shutdown was found, so there is no outcome to explain yet.
notes: Aggregators list $500K seed or pre-seed; unverified and not recorded as a round. Crunchbase shows pre-seed with no amount. Team size differs between YC (2) and one analysis (about 5).
